text:
alex: noticed a sudden tail-latency spike on eu-west1 inference pool around 10:22 UTC, looks correlated with a cluster of GPU errors.
priya: saw that in dashboards, 99th jumped from 120ms to ~2.1s for a handful of routes.
diego: which nodes are noisy? any pattern by rack or host firmware?
alex: host ids: euw-rack7-03..06 (4 hosts). PM reports temps hitting 91-93C on average and GPUs going into power-limit throttling. Logs attached below.
alex: ```nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,temperature.gpu,power.draw,power.limit,utilization.gpu --format=csv -l 1
index, temperature.gpu [C], power.draw [W], power.limit [W], utilization.gpu [%]
0, 93, 290.5, 300, 98
1, 92, 287.1, 300, 99
...``` 
sam: ugh, temps that high will hit boost clocks down. any ECC or Xid errors in dmesg?
alex: yes, saw repeated Xid 31/13 lines and an ECC corrected flood on card1 on rack7-04.
priya: is PSU rail flapping possible? we saw similar tail before where the P12->P0 transitions failed and nv-host logged pwr capping.
diego: can you paste the `dmesg | grep -i nvidia` snippet?
alex: ```
[ 12345.678901] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:3b:00): 31
[ 12345.679002] NVRM: RmInitAdapter failed!
[ 12346.000321] NVRM: GPU at 0000:3b:00: GPU has fallen off the bus.
[ 12346.100012] nvidia 0000:3b:00: GPU reports corrected ECC error
``` 
ruth: can we confirm inlet temps for the rack? if datacenter ambient rose, fans might be maxed and still not enough.
alex: inlet sensors show +6C vs baseline. CRAC target was stable, so localized hotspot likely. Rack's top-of-row switch shows higher intake temps.
sam: quick mitigation: drain the 4 hosts from pool and route traffic to other zones. That buys time for physical triage.
priya: agree. schedule a drain now? will start cordoning and migrate pods. recommends setting weight=0 for eu-west1-rack7 in the scheduler.
diego: ops: also run `nvidia-smi -pl 250` to drop power limit temporarily if we need to preserve availability. lowers perf but prevents thermal runaway.
alex: doing a coordinated drain now. I also kicked off a telemetry capture: nv-hostengine logs and BMC sensor dump.
infra-bot: auto-alert: node euw-rack7-04 drained; migration started. Reroute policy applied.
priya: can we open an issue with vendor for RMA on two cards that show repeated Xid 31? include serials and BMC power cycle history.
alex: will gather serials + grep for PSU WARN/Voltage excursion in syslog.
sam: long-term: let's add a runbook step to detect the P12->P0 failure signature and proactively limit batch sizes when sustained temp>88C for >2m.
dry: (typo) diego: +1 to runbook.
ruth: also check fan controller firmware version; last week we rolled fc-fw 2.3.1 in other racks and saw improved PWM response.
diego: if hardware swap not immediately possible, we can schedule a temporary routing policy: shift heavy requests to dedicated pool in us-west while eu-west cools.
alex: post-mortem action items: 1) RMA cards 2) confirm PSU rail logs with colo 3) add telemetry alarm for sustained thermal throttle 4) update runbook to include immediate drain + -pl fallback.
priya: adding tasks to eng-infra board and pinging colo on-call.
oncall-bot: incident created: INC-2026-3223, assigned to priya, priority P2.
alex: thanks team. will post ETA for hardware swap after vendor reply. :thumbsup:
